description: Surface observations from Desert Rock and Penn State test whether air temperature and humidity explain downward thermal radiation. Competing equations separate blackbody emission from effective sky emissivity; clouds and vertical structure remain unresolved.
limitations: Two sites only: the test set is site transfer to Penn State, not independent replication across many climates
All retained weather conditions are included; the clear-sky-inspired prior may fail under clouds
Hourly point selection and QC exclusions are completely recorded; no target-based outlier filtering
Tetens saturation pressure is a disclosed deterministic preprocessing prior
